info.description: This dataset is composed of raw annotations of aerial imagery of wintering migratory waterfowl. Imagery was collected at Bosque del Apache National Wildlife Refuge and Maxwell National Wildlife Refuge from 2017-2018. At Bosque del Apache NWR, a DJI Mavic Pro 2 equipped with a Hasselblad L1D-20c sensor was deployed; at Maxwell NWR, a Sensefly EBEE+ equipped with a S.O.D.A. sensor was deployed. Fifteen professional wildlife biologists from the US Fish and Wildlife Service were recruited to label a set of 12 images via the Labelbox platform (https://www.labelbox.com); identifying information has been removed but labeler ID has been preserved in this dataset. Contact the Center for the Advancement of Spatial Informatics Research and Education (ASPIRE, aspire@unm.edu) for more information.
